summaryDeep: Their uncompromising autonomy works easily with how you present yourself and enter situations, making it simpler to show a less edited side of yourself around them. You may feel less need to soften your reactions or shape yourself around expected approval. The ease supports directness, but it does not make every refusal healthy or every impulse a mandate.
